notes.title: AI Voice and Mermaid Quest
notes.content:
[h1]Mermaid Quest completed![/h1]
[h2] * Added AI voice to Mermaid quest[/h2]
[h2] * Added AI voice to 40% of the game [/h2]
[h2] * Over 2200 voice overs current[/h2]
[h2] * 600 Left to do[/h2]
[h3] *****Warning******[/h3]
[h3] Audio and music are horrible; unmute at your own risk [/h3]
[h3] Grammer also is not good; this adds to the audio even being worse[/h3]
[h3] 30% or more of the audio must be redone, but the conversations are understandable.[/h3]
[h3] Strongly recommend against using these clips to master the English language.[/h3]
[h3] **** I hope someone enjoys the audio; I had a great time creating them. [/h3]
[h3] **** Recipee for audio, 
       1. Run the script via AI Model for each dialog and return five audio files that sound completely different.
       2. Laugh at each one until I find the most ridiculous one.
       3. Keep doing this until I have the most insane-sounding conversations I have ever heard.
[/h3]

notes.title: Weekly Patch and Story Lines
notes.content:
[h1]
Weekly Patch Improvements May 2024

[/h1]

* Update random battles to have pre and post-events.

notes.title: Highland Patch
notes.content:
[h1]Highland Patch[/h1]

* 4 out of the 5 town characters can now lose their top during combat.
  * Power punches and criticals now cause clothes to come off.
* Enemy and Player Characters have a small chance of missing in combat.
* Player Character critical chances increased.
  * Instant Mana if player criticals. 
  * Critical chance increases as player levels.
* Removed debug text about quest requirements and added a screen that is easier to read.
